status: Raster concept art in SVG style; not a production SVG puppet
prompt:
Create a cohesive CAST CONCEPT SHEET with EIGHT large head-and-shoulders portraits: FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, warm flat ivory background, generous margins. Characters per column: BLUE-HAIRED WOMAN, DARK-HAIRED MAN, FROG WIZARD, WOODEN WANDERER. Top row relaxed / curious; bottom row an exaggerated delightful or awkward expressive reaction with an optional hand by the face. No full bodies. Small column names only at top.

REFERENCE ROLES ARE CRITICAL:
Image 1 is the human design exploration: use ONLY THE MIDDLE COLUMN B / SQUASHY STORYBOOK as the foundation for the two humans. Preserve its enormous cream-white eyes with small pupils, broad lumpy cheeks, short rounded face, wide crooked grin and compact shoulders. Do not use columns A or C. The middle male has an erroneous purple cheek mark: REMOVE it completely. Only the WOMAN has a purple cheek marking.
Images 2 and 3 are the APPROVED ART STYLE AUTHORITY and approved frog/wood character designs. Match their organic ink, shape detail, restrained colors and flat illustrated material shading across the entire cast. Preserve their existing character designs as comparison characters, not redesigned species.

The goal is to REDRAW THE TWO HUMANS so they belong in the same game as the frog and wooden puppet. The human sheet was too clean/sticker-like and had different eye/hair rendering. Use confident slightly irregular tapered near-black hand-inked contours, with thinner purposeful interior curves. Gentle crooked shapes, slightly angular flat shadow patches, muted mineral/earth colors, a few simple clothing folds. Similar level of purposeful detail on all four characters. Flat SVG-ready color regions, no gradients, no painterly texture, no 3D render, no airbrush, no glossy lighting. Playful dark-fairytale cartoon game direction, with grotesque warmth and hand-drawn character.

Woman: warm pale peach skin, broad compact adult cartoon face, huge OFF-WHITE round oval eye shapes with simple small GREEN iris discs and black dot pupils; asymmetric brows, small blunt nose, wide crooked simple tooth band when smiling. Tousled asymmetrical deep teal-blue bob with a few broad curved clumps and one or two purposeful internal ink curves, no spiky anime hair. Purple angular marking on anatomical LEFT cheek (viewer right in a front view). Simple dark buckle choker, muted slate shoulder plates, small glove hand. No eyelashes, pretty pointed chin, realistic lips or anime eyes.
Man: warm tan/brown skin, large cream-white rounded eye shapes with small brown/black pupils, thick worried expressive eyebrows, broad small bulbous nose, broad cheeks. Scruffy near-black hair in several irregular curved clumps, simple little moustache AND small chin beard patch, oversized dark plum scarf, muted brown leather shoulders with one ochre clasp. NO cheek marks, NO purple face paint. Charming awkward crooked smile, one hand on cheek in bottom row.
Frog: keep approved huge amber eyes, turquoise face, broad rubbery toothless mouth, floppy dark plum wizard hat with cream spiral motifs and dark scarf. Upper row curious tilted head, lower row inflated throat and surprised eyes, webbed fingers near cheek.
Wood: keep approved ivory carved upper mask, ochre segmented hinged lower jaw, simple dark hollow eye sockets and cream glints, shaggy broad straw strips, short log horns with burgundy wraps and one bead, olive scarf, slate shoulder plate. Upper row crooked calm smile; lower row delighted hinged open jaw and wood fingers held up.

Human expressions need similarly lively brows, squashy cheeks and huge smiles as their preferred middle-column portraits, but harmonized with the frog/wood styling. All four have the same perceived scale, dark border density, restrained palette, and drawing finish. Human anatomy stays human; do not give humans wood masks or frog eyes. Keep the character-specific eyes distinct while all feel authored by the same artist. NOT ANIME, NOT MANGA, NOT DISNEY, NOT semi-realistic fantasy. Eight separate beautifully readable oversized portrait studies only.
